method: For each arm, arithmetic mean of all 21 recorded rows. Each of seven tasks has three trials, so this also equals the mean of task means. Gap = raw-claude mean minus routed-lean mean. No model calls or new performance trials.
limitations: Observed point differences, not a guaranteed preparation budget or population estimate.
Historical familiar task set and bundled intervention; no isolated System One effect.
Recorded time excludes final external checks, template copy, and environment setup.
Recorded cost omits some router/issue judgments and unused preparation.
Preparation or additional context can change executor behavior and checking cost; the arithmetic holds only if other components remain unchanged.
Task-cluster sensitivity interval for the original time ratio includes 1.
